Commentary.Commentary: ...THE CHASE...

Afghanistan opted to bowl first and it has already backfired a lot. The opening bowlers were too soft and it just gave a feeling how their day was going to look out. Too many soft balls, too many boundary balls and certainly it has cost much. The damage has been done! Afghanistan have an uphill task, the pitch is good enough to bat but won't be easy against the likes of Wanindu Hasaranga and Maheesh Theekshana! The openers have to give a special start. Can they though?

Sri Lanka have posted an above-par total. They way they started, they sensed a big score was coming. Pathum Nissanka and Avishka Fernando laid the foundation and put up an 182-run opening stand. Avishka Fernando was back among the runs after some while, he fell but Pathum Nissanka stitched his place and continued to deal in boundaries. He and Sadeera Samarawickrama batted well to get things going. There was intent right till the end. However, the poster boy of the day, Pathum Nissanka steal the show with his extraordinary double-ton.

Cometh the hour, cometh the man! First Lankan to hit a double-century has arrived! Sanath Jayasuriya, from the stands, is very happy to see an opener hit a marathon innings. Just brilliant from Pathum Nissanka! A proud moment for Nissanka and he will cherish this moment forever.
FOUR! Yes, there is! Fuller and outside off, Nissanka smacks it over covers and it races to the fence. THE LANKANS END WITH 381

Commentary.Commentary: Time for the national anthems. It will be of the visitors first followed by that of the hosts. All done! Time for action. The players are out in the middle. Pathum Nissanka and Avishka Fernando to open for the Lankans. Fazalhaq Farooqi to bowl first. Here we go...

Sri Lanka (PLAYING XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Avishka Fernando, Kusal Mendis (C/WK), Sadeera Samarawickrama, Charith Asalanka, Janith Liyanage, Wanindu Hasaranga, Maheesh Theekshana, Dilshan Madushanka, Dushmantha Chameera, Pramod Madushan.

Afghanistan (PLAYING XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Ibrahim Zadran, Rahmat Shah, Hashmatullah Shahidi (C), Ikram Alikhil (WK), Azmatullah Omarzai, Gulbadin Naib, Mohammad Nabi, Noor Ahmad, Fazalhaq Farooqi, Fareed Ahmad.
TOSS - Afghanistan have won the toss and will BOWL first.

Afghanistan on the other hand will be without Rashid Khan but are bolstered with a lot of familiar faces back in the squad. Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Qais Ahmad or Noor Ahmad could come in really handy. The pitch in the Asian continents tends to help the spinners more so the toss will be very crucial for both the teams. Stay tuned for the updates.

Hello and welcome to the first ODI between Sri Lanka and Afghanistan. After the only test, it is time for the white-ball series to take place and both Asian sides will be keen to make the most of the series. A flurry of changes will be seen in this series. The hosts will be keen to make the most of the home conditions. The likes of Wanindu Hasaranga, Maheesh Theekshana are back with Kusal Mendis leading the troop. They are certainly the favourites with their bowling frowns.
...MATCH DAY...

The Afghanistan cricket team is all set for the ODI series against Sri Lanka. The hosts emerged victorious in the only test match and with this ODI both teams will fight hard with the white ball. The first ODI will be played at the Pallekele International Cricket Stadium. Sri Lanka have been dominant in the last 5 ODI matches against Afghanistan winning three of them. They also clinched a series victory against Zimbabwe in the same format. They will want to keep their dominance and use the home conditions to the fullest. Afghanistan, on the other hand will be playing their first ODI series after the 2023 ODI World Cup. They have been playing the T20I format since then and recently concluded a series against India in similar conditions. Hashmatullah Shahidi will be leading the squad with Rahmat Shah as his deputy. They will have the services of their superstars like Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Mohammad Nabi, Gulbadin Naib, Ibrahim Zadran, and Mujeeb Ur Rahman among others. They need the early win to gain confidence and will want to win the white ball series which will consist of ODI's and T20I's. The three-match ODI series will be a great opportunity for them to bounce back after their last 2 losses in the World Cup. Which team are you supporting?
